title: Question 8
passage:
Has the skating rink posted the beginner schedule on its website yet?
A. I left my skates in the car. B. The beginners meet by the north entrance. C. The website still lists only the advanced sessions.
passageZh:

A. 我把冰鞋留在車上了。 B. 初學者在北側入口集合。 C. 網站上還是只列了進階時段。
